AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Water: seedbed pits? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Water: seedbed pits.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products.

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Erosion? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Erosion.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Erosion.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Erosion.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Erosion.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Good Grooming cleaning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Laundry: Stain Removal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Crocheting of Personal Protective Equipment 16 4.2 Constructing Moist Bed Garden and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
